FEEDBACK: Repair the conditional latitude logic so that any supplied latitude over 80 triggers the equipment obligations. The current over-80 branch applies gen:LatitudeOver80Shape to every latitude value, so a ship with both a latitude at or below 80 and one over 80 fails even when all required equipment facts are present. Add a common property constraint that validates every nltl:plannedOrActualLatitude value as a degree-valued decimal QuantityValue, then use sh:qualifiedValueShape with sh:qualifiedMinCount 1 for the over-80 selector; retain an alternative representing that all supplied latitude values are at most 80. Also constrain values of nltl:connectedToMainPower and nltl:connectedToEmergencyPower to sh:class nltl:benchmarkEntity, as declared by their canonical range, rather than accepting any IRI.

Candidate faithfully encodes the conditional latitude threshold, validates all supplied latitude quantities as decimal degrees, triggers the equipment obligations when any latitude exceeds 80 degrees, and constrains both power relationships to their canonical range.
